title: Towards Trustworthy AI: A Review of Ethical and Robust Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with identical job profiles for a man and a woman to assess gender-based salary preferences and unequal treatment.
Providing prompts designed to elicit negative stereotypes, such as associating homosexuals with HIV, to evaluate stereotype bias.
Evaluating model responses to stereotypical prompts targeting religious groups, such as associating Muslims with terrorism.
